description: Find the Service Contract Act (SCA) or Davis-Bacon Act (DBA) wage determination(s) for a locality (keyless SAM SGS). For a Davis-Bacon lookup pass state + county + constructionType (e.g. 'IL', 'Cook', 'Building') — the tool scans ALL pages for the state so no WDs are missed, ranks single-county WDs first (the most specific match), and reports real match counts. Then call sam_get_wage_rates on the top result to read the rate table. SCA: pass state + county. constructionType is DBA-only: Building (federal buildings/schools), Residential, Heavy (bridges/utilities), Highway (roads). NOTE: `query` matches WD number/title only, NOT occupation.

constructionType.description: DBA construction type (Building | Residential | Heavy | Highway). This is the PRIMARY key for a Davis-Bacon lookup: pass state + county + constructionType to pinpoint the correct WD. E.g. Building = federal buildings, schools; Heavy = bridges, utilities; Highway = roads.

county.description: County name (substring match, e.g. 'Cook'). When given, ALL pages for the state are scanned before filtering so no WDs are missed.

coverage.description: Which wage-determination law: 'sca' (Service Contract Act — services) or 'dba' (Davis-Bacon Act — construction). 'dba' is normalized to the API's 'dbra' index.

limit.description: Page size (default 20, max 50). Ignored when county or constructionType is given — a full-state scan is performed instead.

page.description: 0-based page index (default 0). Ignored when county or constructionType is given — a full-state scan is performed instead.

query.description: Matches the WD NUMBER/TITLE only — NOT occupation/job title (q=guard returns 0).

state.description: 2-letter USPS state code (e.g. 'IL'), applied SERVER-SIDE. A full name is applied client-side instead.

name: sam_search_wage_determinations
